name: Dolphins Mercury
description: Mercury levels (ppm) in muscle tissue of 19 Risso's dolphins. Classic small-sample bootstrap CI example.
studyDescription: Mercury concentrations measured in the muscle tissue of 19 Risso's dolphins (Grampus griseus) in the Ligurian Sea. The dolphins were stranded or bycaught, and tissue samples were analyzed for total mercury content. This is an observational study with a small, non-random sample.

variableDescriptions.mercury: Total mercury concentration in muscle tissue in parts per million (ppm)

sourceDetail: IMS Ch. 19. Data from the openintro R package (dolphins). Original study: Fossi et al. (2003), mercury contamination studies in Mediterranean cetaceans.

inferenceContexts.parameter: the population mean mercury level in Risso's dolphins
inferenceContexts.claim: the average mercury level in Risso's dolphins exceeds the 5 ppm safety threshold
